Understanding the Needs of Language Tutors

Before building a client management system, it's essential to understand the unique needs of language tutors. These needs may include managing client information, scheduling lessons, tracking progress, and handling payments. A well-designed client management system should be able to accommodate these needs and provide a seamless experience for both the tutor and the client.

With Base44, you can create a customized system that addresses these needs. For example, you can design a client intake form to collect relevant information, such as language proficiency level, learning goals, and availability.
